name: Dentists
seoTitle: AI Website Audit for Dentists — Free Website Health Check
metaDescription: Free AI website audit built for dental practices. Find out why your site isn't converting more new patient enquiries — in under 30 seconds.
intro: Choosing a dentist is a high-trust, often anxious decision, and most people research online before ever calling. A dental practice website needs to do more than list treatments — it needs to feel calm, professional, and easy to book with, or nervous visitors simply move on to the next search result.
painPoints: Booking process buried several clicks deep instead of a prominent "Book an Appointment" button visible on every page
No accessibility considerations for older or anxious patients — small text, low contrast, or forms with no clear labels create unnecessary friction
Missing or thin content on specific treatments (e.g. Invisalign, implants, emergency dentistry), losing high-intent searches to practices with dedicated treatment pages
No structured data or visible opening hours, making it harder for anxious patients to quickly confirm you're open and reachable
whyItMatters: Dental websites convert on reassurance and accessibility as much as on services offered — patients are often anxious, sometimes in pain, and want the path from "searching" to "booked" to feel effortless. Practices that pair clear treatment information with an accessible, fast, easy-to-navigate site consistently see more new patient enquiries than those relying on reputation alone.

faq.question: Should each dental treatment have its own page?
faq.answer: Yes — dedicated pages for high-intent treatments like Invisalign, implants or teeth whitening let you target the specific searches patients make, rather than hoping a generic "Services" page ranks for everything at once.

faq.question: How important is accessibility for a dental practice website?
faq.answer: Very — your patient base likely includes older adults, anxious first-time visitors, and people researching mid-emergency, so clear text sizing, good contrast, and properly labelled booking forms directly affect how many enquiries you convert.

faq.question: What's the single highest-impact fix for a dental website?
faq.answer: A prominent, always-visible "Book an Appointment" call-to-action — dental sites that bury booking behind multiple clicks lose a significant share of visitors who would have converted with one clear, obvious next step.
